purpose: Prove isolated, fixed-anchor weapon effects before creating a versioned extension of the approved pack.

style.perspective: strict side view, effect travels or emits toward the right

frames.prompt: Create one original isolated pixel-art Arc Launcher projectile sprite, strict side view travelling right. A compact elongated cyan plasma core with a restrained violet electrical halo and two short trailing sparks, readable at 48x24 pixels. Use crisp hard pixel clusters, no gradients, no antialiasing, no weapon, no character, no text, no shadow, no floor, no border, and no other objects. Center the projectile. Use only dark gunmetal, cyan, violet, pale blue, and white. The entire background, including every enclosed empty area, must be a perfectly flat solid pure green #00ff00 chroma field.

Create frame 1 of 4 of one isolated pixel-art Arc Launcher muzzle flash, strict side view emitting right. Ignition phase: a tiny concentrated cyan-white spark begins at the exact left-center edge, with one restrained violet arc. Crisp hard pixel clusters, no gradients, no antialiasing, no weapon, no projectile, no character, no text, no shadow, no floor, no border, no other objects. Keep all energy connected to the left-center emission point and leave generous empty space. The entire background and every enclosed empty area must be perfectly flat solid pure green #00ff00.
